technology.title: Mechanical
technology.text: Powered by a wound mainspring and hundreds of tiny parts. Manual-wind watches need winding daily; automatics wind via the motion of your wrist.

technology.title: Quartz
technology.text: A battery sends current through a quartz crystal that vibrates 32,768 times a second, giving accuracy within a few seconds a month.

technology.title: Solar / Eco-Drive
technology.text: Any light source charges a rechargeable cell, so the watch can run for years without a battery change.

technology.title: Smart
technology.text: Sensors, GPS and Bluetooth track health and sync notifications from your phone to your wrist.

technology.title: Sapphire Crystal
technology.text: Synthetic sapphire is second only to diamond in hardness and is highly scratch resistant.

technology.title: Water Resistance
technology.text: Gaskets and screw-down crowns seal the case. Ratings are in metres or ATM (10m is roughly 1 ATM).

faq.q: How long does a watch repair take?
faq.a: Battery and strap changes are done same day. Servicing a mechanical movement typically takes 2 to 4 weeks.
